Aisha (People Ops): FYI I made a "retro-fit" self-review template for PMs who ship cross-functional projects. short, behaviorally anchored, and easy to paste into Asana / PRs :clipboard:
Tom (Product Lead): this is great. can we make the 'impact' line include both user and business metric?
Aisha (People Ops): yep. format: one-line impact (user metric + biz metric), then 2 bullets for cross-team coordination, then one learning
Dee (IC): add an optional "handoff notes" line for next PM or engineering owner
Aisha (People Ops): added. also included a manager micro-script for recognizing cross-team negotiation in 1:1s
Scheduler Bot: reminder  calibration window opens in 9 days. please ping your teams (auto)
Tom (Product Lead): paste the block so i can copy to the PM weekly
Aisha (People Ops): pasted below 

--- paste-ready: PM cross-functional self-review (compact) ---
- Impact (1 line): user metric + biz metric (e.g., "reduced time-to-first-purchase by 18% -> +5% revenue lift")
- Coordination highlights: 2 bullets (who, what was negotiated)
- Handoff notes (optional): quick next steps for the next owner
- Biggest learning: one sentence

--- manager micro-script ---
- "Noticed you navigated some tricky trade-offs with Eng/Design. What would you do differently next time and what support would you want?"

--- end paste ---

Dee (IC): exactly the right length. thanks Aisha
Aisha (People Ops): i'll upload to the goals hub under PM templates and shoot a note in the product channel later today :sparkles:
